assumptions.sky: Uniform upper hemisphere: scale*50000*(frequency/20MHz)^(-2.5) K; scales 0.3,1,3 are scenarios, not measured bounds
assumptions.target: sky power >= 4*(all receiver + bias + protection noise), for both selected receptor modes; regolith emission reported separately as ground_over_sky
assumptions.capacitance: Complete differential input, including package/protection/feed/PCB; all four loads change jointly
assumptions.noise: Independent channels; e/i uncorrelated in main sweep; explicit rho screen uses |rho|=0.5 at eight phases
assumptions.temperature_screen: Passive resistors only: -173.15 to +125 C; ground term at 200/250/260 K; C=3 pF, en=0.7 nV/rtHz and in=0.1 pA/rtHz held at requirement limits, series R=10 ohm, |rho|=1 at 72 common phases; not device temperature prediction or qualification
assumptions.scope: Nominal ideal station at sparse frequency samples; no hardware feasibility, source-direction ranking, continuous-band or absolute science-performance claim
